name: Jealous pony
tips: `cowsay` draws a cow saying your text. Pipe another command into it: `fortune | cowsay`.
`cowsay -l` lists the other animals it can draw, and `cowsay -f dragon hello` uses one of them.
A pipe `|` sends the output of the command on its left to the input of the command on its right.
personal: A cow? Why always the cow?
I can say things too, you know.
